bibleRendered.title: Bible Rendered Room
bibleRendered.subtitle: Memorize the entire Bible using just ~50 master symbols — one image per 24-chapter block
bibleRendered.systemDescription: The Bible Rendered system compresses 1,189 chapters into approximately 50 master images. Each symbol represents a 24-chapter block and captures its dominant theme. Learn them all and you can mentally scan the entire Bible in under a minute.
bibleRendered.masterAllSymbols: Master all ~50 symbols and you can recall the entire Bible's structure from memory.
bibleRendered.aboutDescription: The Bible Rendered room is part of Floor 1 (Furnishing) in the Phototheology Palace. It teaches you to compress entire sections of Scripture into single, memorable images.
bibleRendered.coreQuestionText: If I had to represent these 24 chapters with ONE image, what would it be?
bibleRendered.purposeText: To build a mental map of the entire Bible that you can recall instantly. This room trains you to think in compressed symbols.
bibleRendered.learnModeDesc: Start by studying the symbols and their chapter ranges.
bibleRendered.symbolToRangeDesc: See a symbol, recall which chapters it represents.
bibleRendered.rangeToSymbolDesc: See a chapter range, recall the symbol.
bibleRendered.nameToSymbolDesc: See the theme name, recall the symbol.
bibleRendered.fullQuizDesc: Mix all drill types for comprehensive review.

imageBible.title: Phototheology Image Bible
imageBible.subtitle: Every chapter of the Bible as a visual flashcard — memorize Scripture through images
imageBible.searchPlaceholder: Search by book, theme, or keyword...
imageBible.completeBibleDescription: Every chapter of every book — from Genesis to Revelation — represented by a unique visual card.
imageBible.selectBookDescription: Choose a book from the Browse tab to begin studying its chapters with flashcards.
imageBible.testDescription: Select books and chapter ranges to test your memory of the Image Bible.
imageBible.chapterRangeHelp: Only chapters within this range will be included in the test.
imageBible.testTip1: Look at the image and try to recall the book, chapter, and theme before flipping.
imageBible.testTip2: Be honest with yourself — mark incorrect if you didn't fully recall it.
imageBible.testTip3: Focus on missed questions afterwards to strengthen weak areas.
imageBible.testTip4: Start with individual books before testing the whole Bible.
imageBible.memoryTip1: Study one book at a time before moving to the next.
imageBible.memoryTip2: Focus on the visual icons — they're designed to trigger memory of the chapter theme.
imageBible.memoryTip3: Use the memory hook phrases to create strong mental connections.
imageBible.memoryTip4: Review regularly — spaced repetition is the key to long-term retention.
